lines.zh: 我贴着碎石走，脚下浮着白光。
lines.en: I skim the rubble with white light underfoot.

lines.zh: 变身之后，这身子轻了不少。
lines.en: After the change this body feels much lighter.

lines.zh: 我朝战场边缘踱步，慢慢来。
lines.en: I pace the battlefield's edge, unhurried.

lines.zh: 影子落在地上，比我本人更亮。
lines.en: My shadow falls brighter than I am.

lines.zh: 我走一步，空气就压下一层。
lines.en: Each step presses the air down a layer.

lines.zh: 这具躯壳的肌肉，我摸得透。
lines.en: I know these muscles through and through.

lines.zh: 我绕着残塔走，数着层数。
lines.en: I circle the broken tower, counting its levels.

lines.zh: 脚步不急，反正你跑不掉。
lines.en: No need to hurry; you can't escape.

lines.zh: 靴底碾过碎石，气托着我。
lines.en: Energy carries me as my boots grind the gravel.

lines.zh: 兹夫尔人的怒火推着我往前。
lines.en: Tuffle fury pushes me forward.

lines.zh: 我走向高处，那里看得远。
lines.en: I head uphill where the view is long.

lines.zh: 披风在身后翻，像面战旗。
lines.en: My cape rolls behind me like a war banner.

lines.zh: 我捏着拳头，等变身的那一刻。
lines.en: I clench my fist, waiting for the change.
This form isn't the peak.

lines.zh: 我闭眼，听身体里的回响。
lines.en: I close my eyes and listen to the echo inside.

lines.zh: 黄金巨猿还压在我血里。
lines.en: The golden ape still presses at my blood.

lines.zh: 我抬手看了看自己的掌纹。
lines.en: I lift a hand and study its lines.

lines.zh: 风把我的气推成一条线。
lines.en: The wind stretches my ki into a line.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我在想下一步。
lines.en: In the quiet I think of the next move.

lines.zh: 我嘴角有一道旧伤，还在。
lines.en: An old cut at my mouth is still there.
My breathing is slow; ki gathers by degrees.
Where are this world's strong ones?

lines.zh: 我伸开五指，光从掌心漏下。
lines.en: I spread my fingers; light leaks from my palm.

lines.zh: 黄金巨猿在血里翻身，我压住。
lines.en: The Golden Great Ape turns in my blood — I hold it down.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看看天，云在躲我。
lines.en: I glance up; the clouds seem to avoid me.
A little longer. Not yet.
You stand firm. Not enough, though.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是来找死的。
lines.en: I know that look. It's someone seeking death.
Don't hold your weapon that high.
Your ki is smaller than it was.
I grin, and this time it's excitement.
You're afraid of me, aren't you.

lines.zh: 这具身体的原主人认识你吧。
lines.en: This body's old owner knew you, didn't he.

lines.zh: 我不在乎你是谁，只在乎你能撑多久。
lines.en: I don't care who you are, only how long you last.
I raise a hand for you to go first.

lines.zh: 别发抖，那只会让我更快。
lines.en: Don't tremble; it only speeds me up.
Your scent is familiar.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在看一件老物件。
lines.en: I tilt my head like I'm eyeing an old heirloom.
You've no right to stand before me.
Speak. I'm listening.

lines.zh: 你这一身新甲，撑不过三拳。
lines.en: That new armor of yours won't survive three punches.
I want to see whether you cry or laugh.
Now now, don't be in a rush to leave.
Your name won't stick in my memory.
A wound like this doesn't suit this form.
I wipe the blood and let out a laugh.

lines.zh: 你把我的气打散了一瞬。
lines.en: You scattered my ki for an instant.
It hurts, but I'm getting stronger.

lines.zh: 这身体的原主人，也许会谢你。
lines.en: This body's owner might thank you.
I give half a step, then press back in.
Don't think that wins it.
My chest went tight for a moment.

lines.zh: 占有这具身体，我很满意。
lines.en: This body suits me well.
Fine. I'll grant you some skill.
Trading that for your life? Not enough.
I'm reaching. Best not to hide it.
This thing has an odd ki about it.
I'm more interested in energy.

lines.zh: 贝比的种子，早就种下了。
lines.en: Baby's seed was planted long ago.
This body recognizes it.
Give it here and I won't kill you. Today.
I stare without looking away.
Come closer. Don't fear me.
Good. You know your place.
What you hit is a layer of ki.

lines.zh: 我没动，你的肩膀先疼了。
lines.en: I didn't move; your shoulder hurts first.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我看不清你。
lines.en: Not so close; I can't see you properly.
Move back. I can't be bothered to push.
That impact was like rain.
I drop my shoulder and you stagger.
One more bump and I answer it.
Stand firm. Don't fall at my feet.
Your weight means nothing to me.
Back off. I'm charging.
Tuffles recognize only strength.

lines.zh: 这副身体不属于我，别妄想。
lines.en: This body isn't mine to give.

lines.zh: 你若够强，我会多看你一眼。
lines.en: If you're strong enough, I might glance twice.
Love? That's another word for weakness.

lines.zh: 等我拿下这颗星球再说。
lines.en: After I take this planet.

lines.zh: 我连自己都还不算完整。
lines.en: I'm not even whole yet.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我身上有别人的影子。
lines.en: Don't touch me; someone else's shadow is on me.
Your loyalty would be more useful than affection.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我不习惯靠近。
lines.en: Stand further off; I'm not used to closeness.
Don't ask me these things. I've no answers.
These hands are quick at picking things up.
I draw it to my palm with ki.
Just a fragment; I crush it.
Whatever falls counts as spoils.
I weigh it; it's a little heavy.
Keep it. It might be useful.
I don't know this world's materials.

lines.zh: 我一把抓起来，看了两眼。
lines.en: I snatch it up and glance at it twice.
Nothing remarkable.

lines.zh: 这碎片我捏在掌心，碾成粉。
lines.en: I crush the shard to powder in my palm.

lines.zh: 你的气暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your ki gave away your position.
You'll do. Don't let anyone beat me to it.

lines.zh: 你听见风声时，我早换了位置。
lines.en: By the time you hear the wind, I've moved again.
That little resistance is just what I want.

lines.zh: 我感觉到你的气了，很弱。
lines.en: I feel your ki. Very weak.
Aim, then finish it.
Don't think of running; I fly faster.
I'll end this with the Final Flash.
Your steps are disordered; I can hear it.
This shell is urging me to strike.

lines.zh: 终极闪光要蓄三秒，够你跑？
lines.en: The Final Flash takes three seconds — enough time to run?
Good. Prey decided.

lines.zh: 我抬手那一下，你就该跑了。
lines.en: When my hand came up, you should have run.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫，我最喜欢这个。
lines.en: You're hesitating. I love that.
Stop dodging. It's unbecoming.
I count to one, then I move.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，光聚在脚下。
lines.en: I crouch, light gathering under my feet.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，我已经绕后。
lines.en: The afterimage stays; I'm already behind.

lines.zh: 我的气在涨，你感觉得到吗？
lines.en: My ki is rising. Can you feel it?

lines.zh: 你退的方向，正好是我的正面。
lines.en: You're retreating right into my front.
I'll put eighty percent into this one.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，越来越乱。
lines.en: I count your breaths; they're breaking up.
Don't look up; there's a blast above.
That shield won't take two.

lines.zh: 我慢慢逼近，故意让你听见脚步。
lines.en: I close in slowly, letting you hear my steps.
You guard your chest, so I'll take your legs.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，你的视线跟不上。
lines.en: Half a circle and your eyes lose me.
The sound of charging ki is like tearing wind.

lines.zh: 这形态的动作，比刚才快一倍。
lines.en: This form moves twice as fast as before.
Your opening is at your right foot.
That's near enough. I move.

lines.zh: 你这一退，撞到自己的同伴了。
lines.en: That retreat put you into your own ally.
The Death Ball has taken shape.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢拖，但也不介意。
lines.en: I dislike dragging this out, but I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我踢你上天，再追上去补一脚。
lines.en: I kick you skyward and follow up with another.

lines.zh: 空中连击，你被踢得翻了个身。
lines.en: An aerial combo flips you over.

lines.zh: 蓄气突击，直接贯穿你的防线。
lines.en: A charged rush punches clean through your guard.

lines.zh: 终极闪光，别站在正前方。
lines.en: Final Flash. Don't stand in front of it.

lines.zh: 死亡球压下来，地面凹了。
lines.en: The Death Ball lands and the ground dips.
A rapid volley of ki blasts, like a downpour.
My fist goes through your shield.

lines.zh: 你的护甲碎了，声音很脆。
lines.en: Your armor cracks; the sound is brittle.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚踝，甩了出去。
lines.en: I catch your ankle and hurl you.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用的是贝吉塔的力量。
lines.en: That blow used Vegeta's strength.
You blocked it, and your wrist broke.

lines.zh: 死亡球压在头顶，你抬头看。
lines.en: A Death Ball hangs overhead — look up.
Again. I'm not satisfied.
This one is for the Tuffles.

lines.zh: 你连退三步，还是没躲开。
lines.en: Three steps back and you still didn't escape.
I've stopped. Still breathing?
I land and light spreads from my feet.

lines.zh: 这一形态，比刚才更像样。
lines.en: This form suits me better than the last.

lines.zh: 我的气震得碎瓦片跳起来。
lines.en: My ki makes the broken tiles jump.
I look up; the horizon whitens.

lines.zh: 兹夫尔人的意志又深了一层。
lines.en: The Tuffle will sinks deeper.
I crush the step beneath my feet.
This body is running hot.

lines.zh: 变身之后，我更喜欢这里了。
lines.en: After the change, I like this place more.

lines.zh: 我站着，等第一个挑战者。
lines.en: I stand and wait for the first challenger.
Power rolls up from my bones.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，空气都弯了。
lines.en: I exhale and the air bends.
This place will entertain me for a while.

lines.zh: 我抬手，擂台就算立好了。
lines.en: I raise a hand; the arena is set.

lines.zh: 没人在等我，那我自己来。
lines.en: No one's waiting for me, so I'll come myself.
The light settles, and so do I.
The next form is still far off.
Begin. No chatter.
I'm here, planet.

lines.zh: 火烧过我的气壁，只留下热。
lines.en: Fire crosses my barrier and leaves only heat.

lines.zh: 我从空中坠地，砸出裂纹。
lines.en: I hit the ground and crack it.
Underwater my ki disperses quickly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得退了两步。
lines.en: The blast pushes me back two steps.

lines.zh: 箭在气壁上停了一下才破。
lines.en: The arrow pauses on my barrier before piercing it.
This curse binds my ki.
This shell empties too fast.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我身上全是光。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I'm covered in light.
There's no ki to borrow in the void.
